webhooks.detail: Webhooks API: register a URL, list/get/update webhooks under /v1/webhooks; signature verification and IP allowlist documented.

evidence.quote: Brex APIs offer webhooks to notify you in real-time when certain events happen in your account.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or free dev account found. Quickstart assumes existing Brex customer with admin dashboard access. A staging server exists but is explicitly not a sandbox and does not work with customer tokens.

evidence.quote: Staging (Note: This is not a sandbox. It will not work with customer tokens.)

rate_limits.summary: 1,000 requests per 60 seconds per Client ID and Brex account; HTTP 429 when exceeded

evidence.quote: Exceeding a rate limit will result in an HTTP 429 (too many requests) response.
This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification
